description: A $2.8M ARR retail/e-commerce data center customer with predictable Q4 compute demand surges. The platform detects the seasonal pattern from historical data, enables proactive capacity planning by Q3, and times expansion perfectly -- capturing $1.6M in expansion revenue and avoiding $800K in emergency spot capacity costs and SLA penalties.

phases.name: Post-Holiday Baseline
phases.description: Q1 post-holiday cool-down period. Compute demand returns to baseline after last year's Q4 surge. Capacity utilization drops from holiday peak back to normal levels. Health is stable in the low-to-mid 70s. The account runs standard inference and training workloads for recommendation engines and demand forecasting. This calm period establishes the baseline that makes the seasonal pattern detectable.

plot_points.description: Post-holiday QBR with VP Data Science and Infrastructure Director. Review of Q4 surge performance: capacity hit 94% utilization, 3 training jobs failed during peak, inference latency spiked 40%. Agreement that Q4 was barely manageable.

csm_action.description: CSM documents Q4 surge pain points and requests historical utilization data for pattern analysis

plot_points.description: Capacity utilization normalizes to 62% as holiday traffic subsides. Compute Hour Consumption Trend drops 25% MoM. GPU utilization settles at 58%. Baseline workloads are recommendation model retraining (weekly) and demand forecasting inference (continuous).

CSM runs historical pattern analysis across 3 years of utilization data. Clear seasonal pattern emerges: capacity ramps 35-40% every Q4, with peak sustained for 10 weeks. Current infrastructure cannot support another year of growth on top of the seasonal spike.

csm_action.description: CSM produces 3-year seasonal pattern report showing Q4 capacity risk, shares with VP Data Science

phases.name: Pattern Detection
phases.description: The platform's signal analyst detects the seasonal utilization pattern and surfaces it as an expansion signal. VP Data Science validates the pattern against their own demand forecasts. The seasonal model predicts a 45% compute demand increase for Q4, exceeding current capacity by 30%. Health ticks up slightly as the account sees proactive engagement from the CS team.

plot_points.description: Platform signal analyst flags seasonal capacity risk: 3-year trend shows 38% average Q4 compute surge with 6% YoY growth. At current trajectory, Q4 will require 130% of installed capacity. Expansion Probability jumps from 35% to 52%.

CSM presents seasonal capacity forecast to VP Data Science and Infrastructure Director. VP Data Science confirms: their internal demand model for new recommendation engine v3 and real-time personalization will add 15% on top of the seasonal spike. Combined demand: 145% of current capacity.

csm_action.description: CSM schedules capacity planning workshop with customer technical team and internal solutions architect

plot_points.description: Joint capacity planning workshop completed. Infrastructure Director validates hardware requirements: 2 additional GPU racks (64 GPUs), upgraded cooling for sustained load, and network fabric expansion. Total expansion cost estimated at $1.6M. VP Data Science agrees to champion the budget request.

csm_action.description: CSM co-develops capacity expansion proposal with Infrastructure Director, including phased deployment timeline

phases.name: Capacity Planning
phases.description: Budget approval process creates anxiety. CFO questions the $1.6M expansion investment -- wants ROI proof before committing. VP Data Science builds the business case but faces internal pushback from finance team. Health dips into at-risk zone (65) as the planning gap creates uncertainty: the seasonal surge is 18 weeks away and hardware procurement lead time is 12 weeks. Without a decision by week 22, the window closes.

plot_points.description: VP Data Science presents expansion proposal to CFO. CFO pushback: wants to see ROI analysis comparing proactive expansion vs. on-demand spot capacity. Requests cost-of-inaction analysis. Budget Availability Signals drop to 45 as CFO signals caution.

CSM produces comprehensive ROI deck: proactive expansion at $1.6M vs. emergency spot capacity at $2.4M (50% premium) plus $800K SLA penalty risk from degraded performance during surge. Net savings of proactive approach: $1.6M over 2 years. Infrastructure Director flags 12-week procurement lead time -- decision needed by week 22.

csm_action.description: CSM builds CFO-ready ROI model comparing proactive expansion vs. reactive spot capacity, quantifying SLA penalty exposure

plot_points.description: Early seasonal signals appear: Compute Hour Consumption begins trending upward 8% MoM as pre-holiday product development ramps. GPU utilization creeps from 58% to 63%. Training job queue times increasing. The surge is starting earlier than last year.

CSM escalates procurement timeline risk to VP Data Science: 4 weeks remain before the decision window closes. Health score dips to 65 as capacity planning uncertainty weighs on the account. VP Data Science arranges urgent CFO follow-up.

csm_action.description: CSM escalates procurement deadline risk, arranges CFO meeting with updated seasonal demand data showing earlier-than-expected ramp

phases.name: Pre-Surge Expansion
phases.description: CFO approves the $1.6M expansion budget after seeing the ROI analysis and early seasonal signals. Hardware procurement begins immediately. Infrastructure Director oversees phased deployment: first rack online by week 28, second rack by week 32. Health recovers from the planning-gap dip as expansion hardware comes online and the account sees tangible investment. Capacity utilization trajectory turns strongly positive.

plot_points.description: CFO approves $1.6M expansion budget. Key factors: CSM's ROI analysis showing $800K in avoided emergency costs, VP Data Science championing the investment, and early seasonal demand signals confirming the forecast. Purchase orders issued for 2 GPU racks, cooling upgrades, and network fabric expansion.

First GPU rack (32 GPUs) delivered and installation begins. Infrastructure Director oversees deployment with minimal disruption to production workloads. Cooling system upgrades completed in parallel. Capacity utilization drops to 52% as new capacity comes online before demand ramps.

First rack fully operational and validated. VP Data Science migrates recommendation engine v3 training to new GPUs. GPU utilization on new rack reaches 45% within first week. Training Job Completion Rate holds strong at 94%. Health score recovers to 75.

csm_action.description: CSM coordinates workload migration plan with VP Data Science, validates new capacity against surge demand model

plot_points.description: Second GPU rack (32 GPUs) installed and operational. Full expansion capacity online with 2 weeks to spare before surge period. Combined fleet: 192 GPUs with N+1 cooling. Load testing confirms system can sustain 95% utilization without thermal or performance degradation. Health score reaches 78.

phases.name: Surge Period
phases.description: Q4 holiday surge arrives exactly as predicted. Compute demand ramps 42% over baseline across 10 weeks. The expanded infrastructure absorbs the entire surge with zero downtime, zero SLA breaches, and no emergency spot capacity needed. GPU utilization peaks at 88% on expanded fleet (vs. the 130%+ that would have overwhelmed the old infrastructure). Health score climbs to 82 as the investment proves its value. CFO sees predictive ROI validated in real time.

plot_points.description: Q4 surge begins. Compute Hour Consumption jumps 18% in first 2 weeks. Real-time personalization workloads for Black Friday preparation drive GPU utilization to 72% across expanded fleet. On old infrastructure this would have been 108% -- impossible without failures. System Uptime holds at 99.95%.

Black Friday / Cyber Monday peak. GPU utilization hits 88% on expanded fleet -- the highest sustained load in account history. All 47 concurrent training jobs complete successfully. Inference latency P95 holds at 38ms despite 3x normal traffic. Zero SLA breaches. VP Data Science calls it the smoothest holiday season in 4 years.

csm_action.description: CSM provides daily surge performance reports to VP Data Science and CFO, highlighting ROI of proactive expansion

plot_points.description: Mid-surge executive review with CFO. CSM presents real-time ROI dashboard: $800K in emergency spot capacity costs avoided, zero SLA penalties (vs. $200K estimated penalty exposure), and 100% training job completion during peak. CFO acknowledges the proactive investment thesis is validated.

csm_action.description: CSM delivers mid-surge ROI report to CFO showing cost avoidance and performance preservation metrics

plot_points.description: Surge period concludes. Final scorecard: 10 weeks of sustained high demand, zero downtime, zero SLA breaches, 100% training job completion, $800K emergency costs avoided. Health score at 82, highest in account history. CFO initiates conversation about extending the predictive capacity planning model to other seasonal patterns. Expansion Probability for next cycle at 68%.
